questions.prompt: LINQ queries can be written against objects that implement:
Which method filters a sequence based on a condition?
questions.explanation: Where keeps elements where the predicate is true.

questions.prompt: When is a LINQ query actually executed?
questions.explanation: LINQ uses deferred execution; it runs when enumerated.

questions.prompt: Calling ______ forces a deferred LINQ query to run and produce a collection.
questions.template: Calling ______ forces a deferred LINQ query to run and produce a collection.
questions.explanation: ToList() materializes the query into a concrete List.

questions.prompt: FirstOrDefault on an empty sequence returns:
questions.explanation: FirstOrDefault returns default(T) instead of throwing on empty.

questions.prompt: Complete the code to print how many words have length > 3.
hints: Count() returns the number of matching elements.

questions.prompt: Complete: get the shortest word by length.
questions.explanation: OrderBy sorts by length; FirstOrDefault picks the first (shortest).

questions.prompt: Which using directive lets you call Where/Select on a List?
questions.explanation: LINQ extension methods live in System.Linq.
